title: The long version of how I got here.
subtitle: A timeline of the moments, missteps, and milestones that turned 'curious kid with a laptop' into a full-stack engineer who ships.

milestones.title: First lines of real JavaScript
milestones.body: Started building tiny browser games and to-do apps. The bug, as expected, never left.

milestones.title: Discovered React
milestones.body: Stumbled into the component model, never went back to vanilla DOM-spaghetti. Spent the year shipping side projects on weekends.

milestones.title: Joined YPSS as a Full Stack Developer
milestones.body: First production codebase, first on-call shift, first taste of 'designing for scale'. Built admin tools used by real humans.

milestones.title: Internship at Xampus + first hackathon win
milestones.body: Animated marketing builds with GSAP, integrated payments and storage. Won a national-level hackathon with a 36-hour MERN build.

milestones.title: Owned a full-stack analytics suite end-to-end
milestones.body: Designed the schema, built the API, shipped the dashboards, and trained the operators. The product still runs daily.

milestones.title: Going independent
milestones.body: Opened up freelance and select full-time conversations. Doubled down on premium 3D web experiences and product-grade builds.

values.title: Default to honesty.
values.body: If a deadline is unrealistic, I say so on day one. If a feature is the wrong call, I push back with options.

values.title: Bias to ship.
values.body: A live product teaches you more in a week than a Figma file teaches you in a month.

values.title: Sweat the seams.
values.body: Loading states, empty states, error states, keyboard support — the small stuff is the brand.
